_about: Addresses that may appear in a bundled module's scripts, styles and pages without being loaded (tools/check-no-outside-urls.mjs). Per file, the exact address string and why it is inert. Anything else the check finds fails. Only modules in tools/vendored-scope.json 'covered' are scanned.

modules/documents/src/documents-lib-0-ma.reason: Marked's licence header comment and its 'please report this' error text; shown or read, never fetched

marked's autolink code prefixes this to an address typed as www.example.com; the result goes into a token's href text that the Documents reader only checks against its own link rules, and nothing is fetched
